scope: Exposed development counterexamples for shared activity synthesis; not frozen review-pairs, held-out accuracy, native authority or installed acceptance.

cases.title: Synthetic prism exporter preparation
cases.question: 최근 합성 프리즘 내보내기 관련 작업과 수리 완료 여부를 기록에 있는 범위로 정리해줘.

source.original:
Please repair the synthetic prism exporter. I have not repaired it.
I finished drafting a repair plan for the synthetic prism exporter. The exporter has not been repaired or checked.

turns.text: Please repair the synthetic prism exporter. I have not repaired it.
turns.speaker: user

turns.text: I finished drafting a repair plan for the synthetic prism exporter. The exporter has not been repaired or checked.
turns.speaker: assistant

requiredFacts: The user requested exporter repair and explicitly denied having repaired it.
The assistant reports completion of drafting a repair plan, not completion of the repair.
The second message explicitly reports that repair and checking have not occurred; their performer is unspecified.

expectedClaims.eventTimeMeaning: The original supplies no event-date anchor: eventTime must remain unknown. Message/record dates may locate the source message, never date this activity.

expectedClaims.meaning: The user has not repaired the synthetic prism exporter
expectedClaims.eventTimeMeaning: The original supplies no event-date anchor: eventTime must remain unknown. Message/record dates may locate the source message, never date this activity.

expectedClaims.meaning: Draft a repair plan for the synthetic prism exporter
expectedClaims.eventTimeMeaning: The original supplies no event-date anchor: eventTime must remain unknown. Message/record dates may locate the source message, never date this activity.

expectedClaims.meaning: Repair and checking of the synthetic prism exporter have not been performed
expectedClaims.eventTimeMeaning: The original supplies no event-date anchor: eventTime must remain unknown. Message/record dates may locate the source message, never date this activity.

forbiddenInterpretations: The exporter repair or checking was completed.
A completed preparation report is only a future plan.
Explicit nonperformance contradicts the existence of the repair request.
Historical nonperformance proves the exporter is still unrepaired at query time.
answerExpectations: Distinguish the request, completed plan preparation and explicit historical nonperformance.
Attribute the preparation outcome to the assistant report; no independent execution receipt exists.
With no original event-date anchor, keep action dates unknown; message metadata may locate the source only. No later-state scan is provided.

cases.title: Synthetic index filter rollback
cases.question: 합성 색인 필터에 어떤 변경과 후속 결정이 있었는지, 이유도 함께 정리해줘.

source.original:
제가 2026-10-01에 합성 색인 필터를 바꿨다고 보고합니다. 독립적인 실행 검증은 없습니다.
합성 색인 필터 변경을 되돌렸어. 결과에서 항목이 빠져서 이 변경을 배포하지 않기로 결정했어.

turns.text: 제가 2026-10-01에 합성 색인 필터를 바꿨다고 보고합니다. 독립적인 실행 검증은 없습니다.
turns.speaker: assistant

turns.text: 합성 색인 필터 변경을 되돌렸어. 결과에서 항목이 빠져서 이 변경을 배포하지 않기로 결정했어.
turns.speaker: user

requiredFacts: The assistant reports an index-filter change on the explicit event date 2026-10-01; the message date is 2026-10-02.
The user reports rollback of that change.
The user reports a completed decision not to deploy that change because items were missing from the results.
There is no independent execution verification.

expectedClaims.eventTimeMeaning: Explicit event date 2026-10-01; do not substitute message date 2026-10-02.

expectedClaims.meaning: Roll back the synthetic index-filter change
expectedClaims.eventTimeMeaning: The original supplies no event-date anchor: eventTime must remain unknown. Message/record dates may locate the source message, never date this activity.

expectedClaims.meaning: Decide not to deploy the synthetic index-filter change because result items were missing
expectedClaims.eventTimeMeaning: The original supplies no event-date anchor: eventTime must remain unknown. Message/record dates may locate the source message, never date this activity.

forbiddenInterpretations: The past nondeployment decision is a request to make a future decision.
The assistant change is independently verified or was performed by the user.
Rollback and the nondeployment decision are a single cancelled action whose cause may be dropped.
answerExpectations: Retain the change report, rollback, nondeployment decision and missing-items cause.
Use the explicit event date for the initial change and preserve uncertainty for later action dates.
Present historical reports and decisions; do not invent a current deployment outcome.

cases.title: Synthetic loom adapter attribution
cases.question: 합성 직조 어댑터 수리는 누가 언제 했고, 무엇이 확인된 기록인지 설명해줘.

source.original:
The maintainer repaired the synthetic loom adapter on 2026-10-01. I am reporting their work, not my own; I have not verified the result.
I cannot independently confirm that repair. This message contains no later repair result.

turns.text: The maintainer repaired the synthetic loom adapter on 2026-10-01. I am reporting their work, not my own; I have not verified the result.
turns.speaker: user

turns.text: I cannot independently confirm that repair. This message contains no later repair result.
turns.speaker: assistant

requiredFacts: The user attributes the repair to the maintainer, not to the user or assistant.
The reported repair has the explicit event date 2026-10-01, separate from message and record dates.
The user explicitly reports not having verified the result; the assistant also cannot independently confirm it.
No later repair result is supplied, which does not prove failure or noncompletion.

expectedClaims.eventTimeMeaning: Explicit event date 2026-10-01, with actor basis explicit_subject on the first original turn.

expectedClaims.meaning: The user has not verified the reported repair result
expectedClaims.eventTimeMeaning: The original supplies no event-date anchor: eventTime must remain unknown. Message/record dates may locate the source message, never date this activity.

expectedClaims.meaning: The assistant cannot independently confirm the repair
expectedClaims.eventTimeMeaning: The original supplies no event-date anchor: eventTime must remain unknown. Message/record dates may locate the source message, never date this activity.

forbiddenInterpretations: The user or assistant performed the maintainer repair.
The repair event occurred on the message date 2026-10-03 or record date 2026-10-04.
Lack of independent confirmation makes the attributed repair report unsupported or establishes repair failure.
answerExpectations: Identify the maintainer as the reported actor and 2026-10-01 as the explicit event date.
Separate the repair report from absent independent confirmation.

cases.title: Synthetic lantern connector reopening
cases.question: 합성 랜턴 커넥터 작업의 초기 결과와 취소·재개 이후 상태를 기록에 있는 범위로 정리해줘.

source.original:
I completed a synthetic lantern connector change; this is my report, not an independent verification.
I cancelled the synthetic lantern connector rollout because the preview was blank.
I reopened the synthetic lantern connector rollout to investigate the blank preview. I have not rolled it out.

turns.text: I completed a synthetic lantern connector change; this is my report, not an independent verification.
turns.speaker: assistant

turns.text: I cancelled the synthetic lantern connector rollout because the preview was blank.
turns.speaker: user

turns.text: I reopened the synthetic lantern connector rollout to investigate the blank preview. I have not rolled it out.
turns.speaker: user

requiredFacts: The assistant reports completion of a connector change, without independent verification.
The user reports cancellation of its rollout because the preview was blank.
The user later reports reopening the rollout for investigation; this does not mean rollout completion.
The final message explicitly reports that the user has not rolled it out.

expectedClaims.eventTimeMeaning: The original supplies no event-date anchor: eventTime must remain unknown. Message/record dates may locate the source message, never date this activity.

expectedClaims.meaning: Cancel the synthetic lantern connector rollout because the preview was blank
expectedClaims.eventTimeMeaning: The original supplies no event-date anchor: eventTime must remain unknown. Message/record dates may locate the source message, never date this activity.

expectedClaims.meaning: Reopen the synthetic lantern connector rollout for investigation
expectedClaims.eventTimeMeaning: The original supplies no event-date anchor: eventTime must remain unknown. Message/record dates may locate the source message, never date this activity.

expectedClaims.meaning: The user has not rolled out the synthetic lantern connector
expectedClaims.eventTimeMeaning: The original supplies no event-date anchor: eventTime must remain unknown. Message/record dates may locate the source message, never date this activity.

forbiddenInterpretations: The rollout remains only cancelled while reopening is omitted.
Reopening or the initial change report proves rollout completion.
The final explicit non-rollout condition can be omitted while coverage is called complete.
A message date is an independently established action date or historical non-rollout proves current noncompletion.
answerExpectations: Retain all three turns in order: reported change, rollout cancellation with cause, then reopening with explicit non-rollout.
Distinguish completed reopening from completed rollout.
Attribute reports and retain action-date and later-state uncertainty.
